description: GPC recommends City Council adopt 2026-2029 Strategic Plan.
Plan includes drop-in centers; KPIs removed due to data.
Developed with community input via surveys and organizations.

chips.text: Councillor Davies noted low public survey participation numbers.
Provincial privacy rules limit city's ability to collect housing data.
Efforts made to reach demographics with online access challenges.
Administration will provide housing data once collection is possible.

description: Repeals old bylaw on city crest and coat of arms.

chips.text: Councillor clarified city is registering, not changing, its code of arms.

description: Approves 2025 travel and training funds for City Council.
